body.label: Trigger
body.html: You or an ally within 3 units is targeted by an Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: A Sprite flickers through the attack. The target gains +1 Defense; if the Action fails, the target may move 1 unit.

surges.html: Increase the Defense bonus from this Reaction by 1.
If the triggering Action fails, the protected creature becomes Rallied.
